William, I'm sorry. Your Harlo B30 missed its November 14 date, and you've had to keep checking with us.

Here's the update you didn't get yesterday. Your B30 now ships with the batch scheduled for November 30, and your free Power K. goes in the same box. It's waiting for you at our Tennessee warehouse.

You'll get tracking by email as soon as it ships. You can follow the B30 shipment on its way to us here: https://heliumdeploy.com/pages/shipment-status
